jobs.prompt:

References define coherent tool construction, illustration style and diagonal orientation; modify the proportions, materials and physical ornament exactly as requested below.
Korean indie-fantasy webtoon plus vintage European storybook, thin natural dark-brown hand-drawn contour, matte flat color with only one or two cel-shadow planes, restrained fine grain INSIDE object surfaces. Square canvas, FULL OBJECT INSIDE 7 percent margins. Head, tip or nozzle at UPPER LEFT, grip or base LOWER RIGHT. Large legible silhouette. Genuine alpha-transparent background, NO background color, checkerboard, floor, cast shadow, frame, text, numerals, labels or UI.
Absolutely NO surrounding sparkles, stars, floating dots, glow, rays, particles, aura, mist, smoke, spray, droplets or loose symbols. Every ornament must be engraved in or physically attached to the tool. No green charm. No actual insects, worms or captured creatures.
SWATTER geometry, when present: a thin FLAT FOUR-SIDED RECTANGLE with gently rounded corners. Opaque ivory face with delicate low-contrast thin tan straight grid lines, roughly 20 tiny cells across. The fine grid recedes at thumbnail size. NO large holes, round perforations, seedpod, honeycomb, sponge, irregular apertures, leaf/oval/racket head.
NET geometry, when present: a round or oval hoop with a soft pouch HANGING BELOW, made of opaque pale-ivory fabric with fine faint crosshatched weave and a few natural folds. No broad open lattice or large holes. Clear difference between pouch net and flat swatter.
Small host/vector emblems are visual memory aids, modest flat engravings, maximum 8 percent of object length; main tool always dominates. Do not put them in the surrounding space.
